author: Im_Tristan
body:
IGN: tristanthewren
Reason banned: Hacking - Kill Aura
Date of ban: 19 January 2016
Time of ban: 7:09:38 PM GMT
Banned by: Jiveh (MOD)
Information: I believe that Jiveh made a mistake when banning me as I have never used a hacked client on any server ever. The only mod that I was using was optifine for 1.8.8 Minecraft. I request that the evidence of the ban is looked at and reviewed by another staff member. I have no proof that I was not hacking as I was not recording my screen at the time of the ban. I believe that this was just a mistake, possibly to do with my connection as my internet is reasonably bad. Thank you for your time.

replies.author: Im_Tristan
replies.body:
Hello Tazz, thank you for taking the time to read my appeal. I have watched the clip myself a few times now and I think that I see why you may have had the idea that I was hacking. Is it the part just after 50 seconds? If so then I would greatly appreciate it if you re-watch that part a few times as you will notice that after I have finishing killing the first person and you say that my head does a 180 turn, I never actually hit that player. They hit me and sent me flying backwards. Because of this I knew they were behind me so killed them.

Again, thank you for reading my reply. I hope that you realise that I wasn't hacking. Thank you
